text: Do you have unexpected happy place/cosy games that help you get out of slumps? For me its the more modern Resident Evil games ( from 7, Remakes included) and the same with Silent Hill (2R, f and Townfall). Dunno why when sometimes it makes me really tense but I also like to save and try to do things perfectly such as sneaking by and using less ammo over and over until I am happy, I know they should be stressful experiences somewhat and they can be, but whenever I hit a slump where my brain won't let me play what I want (most recently The Blood of the Dawnwalker and Control Resonant) these games help me break out of that paralysis and just lock in. Before this it used to be souls games and soulslikes but I think these games require less time investment and it allows me to go back to what I wanted to play faster once I complete a playthrough. So anyone else with unexpected/weird games or types of games they use to get out of their mental blocks and gaming slumps?
